recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add the onion (and pepper) and cook 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chopped tomatoes and ½ tsp salt. Simmer 10 minutes, crushing the tomatoes, until thick.
Make 4 small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook on low for 6 minutes, until the whites are set but the yolks are soft.
Scatter over the feta and parsley and serve straight from the pan with bread.
recipes.tip: If the sauce gets too thick before the eggs go in, add a splash of water.

recipes.name: Hummus
extra: a pinch of paprika, to finish
steps: Put the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and ½ tsp salt in the blender.
Blend for 1 minute, adding 3–4 tbsp of the chickpea liquid or cold water, until very smooth.
Taste and add more lemon or salt if needed.
Spread in a bowl, make a swirl with a spoon, drizzle with oil and sprinkle with paprika and parsley.
recipes.tip: For extra smooth hummus, blend for a full 3 minutes and use ice-cold water.

recipes.name: Lentil soup (Shorbat adas)
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pot. Cook the onion, carrot (and potato) for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and turmeric and stir for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, 5 cups water and the stock cube. Bring to the boil, then simmer 20 minutes until the lentils fall apart.
Blend until smooth, or whisk hard if you have no blender. Add salt to taste.
Serve with lemon wedges and toasted bread.
recipes.tip: Thick soup? Add hot water a little at a time.
recipes.pressure: Fry the onion, carrot, garlic and spices in the pot. Add the lentils, potato, stock cube and 5 cups water. Cook 8 minutes at high pressure, let the pressure drop by itself (about 10 minutes), then blend. Never fill the pot more than half full.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma wraps
need: 500 g chicken thighs or breast, in strips
extra: 3 tbsp tahini or mayonnaise, for the sauce
steps: Mix the yogurt, 2 cloves of the garlic, the juice of half the lemon, the spices, 1 tbsp oil and ½ tsp salt. Stir in the chicken and leave 10 minutes (or overnight in the fridge).
Cook the chicken: in a hot pan with a little oil for 8 minutes, turning, until charred at the edges. Air fryer: 200°C for 12 minutes, shaking halfway. Oven: 220°C for 20 minutes.
For the sauce, mix the tahini or mayo with the last clove of garlic, the rest of the lemon juice and a little water.
Warm the bread, spread with sauce, add the chicken and vegetables, and roll up tightly.
recipes.tip: Thighs stay juicier than breast.

recipes.name: Kofta skewers
need: 500 g minced beef or minced lamb
a big handful of parsley, finely chopped
steps: Squeeze the grated onion to drain its juice. Mix it with the meat, parsley, spices and 1 tsp salt. Knead for 2 minutes.
Shape into 12 fingers with wet hands.
Cook: in a hot oiled pan for 8 minutes, turning often. Air fryer: 200°C for 10 minutes. Oven: 220°C for 15 minutes.
Serve in warm bread with yogurt and cucumber.
recipes.tip: Chill the shaped kofta 15 minutes if they feel soft; they hold together better.

recipes.name: Mujaddara (lentils and rice)
extra: a salad of cucumber or tomato, to serve
steps: Cover the lentils with water and boil for 15 minutes until almost tender. Drain.
Meanwhile fry the onions in 4 tbsp oil over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring, until deep brown. Lift out half for the top.
Add the rice and cumin to the pot with the rest of the onions and stir 1 minute.
Add the lentils, 2 cups water and 1 tsp salt. Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat, fluff with a fork and top with the crispy onions.
recipes.tip: Don't rush the onions: their dark colour is the flavour of the dish. Red lentils go mushy here.
recipes.pressure: Cook the brown or green lentils in 3 cups water for 8 minutes at high pressure instead of boiling them for 15. Release the pressure, drain, and carry on from step 3.

recipes.name: Fattoush salad
steps: Toss the bread pieces with 1 tbsp oil. Toast in a pan for 5 minutes, or air fry at 180°C for 5 minutes, until crisp.
Put all the vegetables and herbs in a big bowl.
Whisk the lemon juice, 4 tbsp oil, sumac, pomegranate molasses and ½ tsp salt.
Just before eating, toss everything with the dressing and the crisp bread.
recipes.tip: Add the bread at the last minute so it stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Foul medames
steps: Warm the beans with their liquid in a small pot for 5 minutes.
Mash about half of them with a fork.
Stir in the garlic, lemon juice, cumin, ½ tsp salt and 2 tbsp oil.
Top with tomato, parsley and chili and serve hot with bread.
recipes.tip: A spoon of tahini makes it creamier.

recipes.name: Chicken machboos
steps: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a big pot and fry the onions 10 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, baharat, turmeric, cinnamon and cardamom and stir 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes, dried limes (pierced) or lemon, 1½ tsp salt and 4 cups water. Simmer covered for 30 minutes.
Lift out the chicken. Measure the broth: you need 3 cups (top up with water). Add the drained rice to the broth.
Cover and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile brown the chicken under the oven grill or in the air fryer at 200°C for 8 minutes. Serve on top of the rice with coriander and raisins.
recipes.tip: Dried limes (loomi) give the real Gulf taste.
recipes.pressure: After browning the chicken (step 3), add the tomatoes, limes, salt and 3½ cups water and cook 10 minutes at high pressure instead of simmering for 30. Release the pressure, then carry on from step 4.

recipes.name: Batata harra (spicy potatoes)
need: a big handful of coriander, chopped
steps: Toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp oil and ½ tsp salt.
Cook until golden: air fryer 200°C for 18 minutes, shaking twice; or oven 220°C for 30 minutes; or shallow-fry in a pan for 15 minutes.
In a pan, warm 2 tbsp oil and fry the garlic, chili and paprika for 1 minute.
Toss the hot potatoes in the garlic oil with the coriander and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.tip: Dry the potato cubes well before oiling; they crisp better.

recipes.name: Masoor dal
need: 2 tomatoes or ½ can chopped tomatoes
steps: Boil the lentils with 3 cups water and the turmeric. Simmer 20 minutes until soft, skimming off any foam.
Meanwhile heat 2 tbsp oil and fry the onion 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, chili and cumin and stir 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Stir the onion mix into the lentils with 1 tsp salt and simmer 5 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander. Serve with rice.
recipes.tip: Ghee instead of oil in the frying step gives a richer dal.
recipes.pressure: Fry the onion, garlic, ginger, chili and cumin in the pot first. Add the tomatoes, the rinsed lentils, turmeric, 1 tsp salt and 2½ cups water. Lock the lid and cook 6 minutes at high pressure, then let the pressure drop by itself (about 10 minutes). Stir well and finish with lemon and coriander. Lentils foam, so never fill the pot more than half full.

recipes.name: Chicken curry
need: 2 tomatoes or ½ can chopped tomatoes
2 tsp garam masala or curry powder
extra: ½ cup yogurt or coconut milk
steps: Heat 3 tbsp oil and fry the onions 10 minutes until golden brown.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili and cook 1 minute. Add the spices and stir 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and 1 tsp salt. Cook 5 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the chicken and stir to coat. Add ½ cup water, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the yogurt or coconut milk and heat gently for 2 minutes without boiling. Top with coriander.
recipes.tip: Take the pan off the heat before adding yogurt so it doesn't split.
recipes.pressure: Make the onion and tomato base in the pot (steps 1–3). Add the chicken and only ¼ cup water. Cook 8 minutes at high pressure, then release the pressure carefully. Stir in the yogurt or coconut milk with the heat off.

recipes.name: Chana masala
need: 2 tsp garam masala or curry powder
steps: Heat 3 tbsp oil, add the cumin for 20 seconds, then fry the onions 10 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute, then the spices for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and 1 tsp salt and cook 5 minutes into a thick sauce.
Add the chickpeas and 1 cup water. Simmer 10 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
recipes.pressure: Using dried chickpeas instead of cans? Soak 1½ cups overnight, then cook them in plenty of water with 1 tsp salt for 15 minutes at high pressure and let the pressure drop by itself. Use them in step 4.

recipes.name: Aloo matar (potato and peas)
need: 1 tsp garam masala or curry powder
steps: Heat 3 tbsp oil, add the cumin for 20 seconds, then the onion for 6 minutes.
Add the ginger, garlic and chili for 1 minute, then the turmeric and garam masala.
Add the tomatoes and 1 tsp salt and cook 4 minutes.
Add the potatoes and 1½ cups water. Cover and simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Add the peas for the last 5 minutes. Top with coriander.
recipes.pressure: Make the base in the pot (steps 1–3), then add the potatoes and only ¾ cup water. Cook 3 minutes at high pressure, release the pressure quickly, stir in the peas and cook 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Egg curry (anda curry)
need: 2 tomatoes or ½ can chopped tomatoes
1 tsp garam masala or curry powder
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool in cold water and peel. Make a few small cuts in each.
Heat 3 tbsp oil and fry the onions 10 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute, then the spices for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and 1 tsp salt and cook 5 minutes. Add 1 cup water and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the eggs and simmer 5 minutes, spooning the sauce over them. Top with coriander.
recipes.tip: Frying the peeled eggs for 2 minutes first gives them a golden skin that holds the sauce.
recipes.pressure: Boil the eggs in the pressure cooker: 1 cup water, eggs on the rack, 5 minutes at high pressure, 5 minutes letting the pressure drop, then straight into cold water. They peel easily.

recipes.name: Keema matar
need: 500 g minced beef or minced lamb
2 tsp garam masala or curry powder
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil and fry the onions 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili for 1 minute.
Add the mince and cook 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the spices, tomatoes, yogurt and 1 tsp salt. Cook 5 minutes, then add ½ cup water, cover and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the peas and cook 5 minutes more. Top with coriander.
recipes.pressure: Brown the onions, garlic, ginger and mince in the pot (steps 1–3). Add the spices, tomatoes, yogurt, salt and ¼ cup water. Cook 6 minutes at high pressure, release the pressure, then stir in the peas and simmer 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken biryani
extra: a pinch of saffron in 3 tbsp warm milk
steps: Mix the chicken with the yogurt, garlic, ginger, garam masala, chili, turmeric and 1½ tsp salt. Leave 20 minutes.
Fry the onions in 4 tbsp oil for 15 minutes until deep brown. Take out half for the top.
Add the chicken and tomatoes to the pot and cook 20 minutes until the chicken is done and the sauce is thick.
Meanwhile boil the drained rice in plenty of salted water with the cardamom, cinnamon and bay leaves for 6 minutes, until three-quarters cooked. Drain.
Spread the rice over the chicken. Top with the fried onions, herbs, saffron milk and ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes. Rest 5 minutes, then mix gently from the bottom as you serve.
recipes.tip: Wrap the lid in a tea towel so no steam escapes.

recipes.name: Vegetable pulao
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil or ghee. Add the cumin, cardamom, cinnamon and bay leaves for 30 seconds.
Add the onion and cook 6 minutes until golden.
Add the vegetables and garam masala and stir 2 minutes.
Add the drained rice, 2¼ cups water and 1 tsp salt. Boil, then cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat and fluff with a fork.
recipes.pressure: Do steps 1–3 in the pot, then add the drained rice, salt and only 1¾ cups water (pressure cookers need less). Cook 4 minutes at high pressure, let the pressure drop by itself for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

recipes.name: Masala omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with all the other ingredients and a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat and pour in the eggs.
Cook 2 minutes until the bottom sets, then fold or flip and cook 1 minute more.
Serve hot with bread.

recipes.name: Bhindi masala (okra)
steps: Wash the okra and dry it completely before slicing.
Fry the okra in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, uncovered, until no longer sticky. Set aside.
In the same pan fry the onion 5 minutes, then add the spices for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and ½ tsp salt and cook 4 minutes.
Return the okra and cook 3 minutes. Finish with lemon juice.
recipes.tip: Never cover okra while it cooks, or it turns slimy.

recipes.name: Tomato and garlic pasta
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water as the packet says, usually 10 minutes.
Meanwhile warm 3 tbsp oil and cook the onion 4 minutes, then the garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and ½ tsp salt. Simmer 10 minutes. Add a pinch of sugar if it tastes sharp.
Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of the water. Toss the pasta in the sauce with a splash of the water.
Serve with basil and cheese.

recipes.name: Garlic and chili spaghetti
steps: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water as the packet says.
Meanwhile warm 5 tbsp oil on low heat with the garlic and chili for 4 minutes, until the garlic is pale gold. Don't let it brown.
Keep ½ cup of pasta water, then drain.
Toss the spaghetti in the garlic oil with a splash of pasta water for 1 minute until glossy.
Add parsley, a squeeze of lemon and cheese.
recipes.tip: Burnt garlic tastes bitter. Start again if it goes dark brown.

recipes.name: Creamy mushroom pasta
extra: a handful of parmesan or cheese
steps: Boil the pasta as the packet says.
Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp oil and the butter over high heat for 6 minutes until browned. Add the onion and garlic for 2 minutes.
If using milk, stir in the flour for 1 minute first. Pour in the cream or milk and simmer 3 minutes until thick.
Add the cheese, salt and pepper, then toss in the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water.
Top with parsley.
recipes.tip: Don't crowd the mushrooms: they brown instead of steaming.

recipes.name: Stovetop mac and cheese
steps: Boil the macaroni 1 minute less than the packet says, then drain.
Melt the butter in a pot, stir in the flour and cook 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk a little at a time. Simmer 4 minutes, stirring, until it thickens.
Off the heat, stir in the cheese, mustard and salt until smooth.
Stir in the macaroni. Optional: top with breadcrumbs and air fry at 190°C for 5 minutes for a crunchy top.

imageCredit.artist: Matt MacGillivray from Toronto, Ontario, Canada

recipes.name: Spanish potato omelette
steps: Cook the potatoes and onion slowly in ½ cup oil in a frying pan for 15 minutes, until soft but not crisp. Drain off the oil.
Beat the eggs with 1 tsp salt. Stir in the potatoes and leave 5 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in the pan, pour in the mix and cook on low for 8 minutes until almost set.
Put a plate over the pan, flip the omelette onto it and slide it back in. Cook 3 minutes more.
Serve warm or cold, in wedges.

recipes.name: Fluffy pancakes
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Whisk the milk, egg and melted butter, pour into the flour and stir until just mixed. A few lumps are fine.
Heat a pan over medium heat with a little oil. Pour in ¼ cup of batter per pancake.
Flip when bubbles appear on top, about 2 minutes, and cook 1 minute more.
Serve with honey and banana.
recipes.tip: Don't over-mix the batter, or the pancakes come out flat.

recipes.name: French toast
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar and cinnamon in a wide dish.
Heat the butter in a pan over medium heat.
Dip each slice in the egg for a few seconds on each side.
Fry 2 minutes per side until golden. Serve with honey and fruit.
recipes.tip: Day-old bread soaks better without falling apart.

recipes.name: Lemon chicken and potatoes
need: 6 chicken thighs or 800 g chicken pieces
steps: Mix 3 tbsp oil, the lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano, paprika and 1½ tsp salt.
Toss the chicken, potatoes and onion in it.
Oven: spread on a tray and roast at 210°C for 45 minutes, turning once, until golden. Air fryer: cook the potatoes at 200°C for 10 minutes, add the chicken and cook 20 minutes more, shaking halfway.
Check the chicken is cooked through (no pink near the bone), then serve with the pan juices.
recipes.tip: Put the squeezed lemon halves on the tray too for more flavour.

recipes.name: Beef burgers
steps: Mix the beef, onion, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Shape 4 patties a little wider than the buns and press a dent in the middle.
Cook in a hot oiled pan for 4 minutes per side. Air fryer: 200°C for 10 minutes, turning halfway.
Add the cheese for the last minute and cover to melt.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with salad and sauces.
recipes.tip: Only flip once and don't press the patties; they stay juicy.

recipes.name: Lemon garlic fish
steps: Mix the garlic, butter or 1 tbsp oil, half the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Brush it over the fish.
Oven: bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes. Air fryer: 190°C for 9 minutes. The fish is done when it flakes easily.
Squeeze over the rest of the lemon and add parsley.

imageCredit.artist: Andy / Andrew Fogg from near Cambridge, UK

recipes.name: Egg fried rice
steps: No cooked rice? Cook 1 cup rice, spread it on a plate and cool it for 20 minutes first.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or big pan over high heat. Fry the garlic, onion and vegetables (and chicken or prawns) for 3 minutes.
Push to one side, crack in the eggs and scramble for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir-fry 3 minutes until hot. Add the soy sauce and sesame oil and toss well.
recipes.tip: Cold rice fries; fresh hot rice turns sticky.

recipes.name: Chicken stir-fry
need: 2 bell peppers or broccoli or carrots
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, cornflour and 3 tbsp water for the sauce.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok on high heat. Stir-fry the chicken 5 minutes until cooked. Take it out.
Stir-fry the vegetables, garlic and ginger 3 minutes; they should stay crunchy.
Return the chicken, add the sauce and toss 1 minute until glossy. Top with spring onions.
recipes.tip: Cut everything before you start: stir-frying is fast.

recipes.name: Garlic soy noodles
extra: a handful of cabbage or spinach
steps: Cook the noodles as the packet says and drain.
Warm 2 tbsp oil and fry the garlic and chili for 1 minute. Add the greens for 2 minutes.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, honey and sesame oil. Toss 1 minute.
Top with spring onions and a fried egg.

recipes.name: Peanut noodles
steps: Cook the noodles as the packet says. Keep ½ cup of the water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, garlic, honey, lime juice and chili with 4 tbsp hot noodle water until smooth.
Toss the drained noodles in the sauce.
Top with cucumber, carrot and spring onions. Eat warm or cold.

recipes.name: Honey soy chicken
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, cornflour and 3 tbsp water.
Pan: fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden. Air fryer: 200°C for 12 minutes, then put it in a pan.
Pour the sauce over and bubble 2 minutes until sticky.
Top with sesame seeds and spring onions. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Thai-style coconut chicken curry
need: 2 tbsp curry paste or curry powder
extra: a handful of basil or coriander
steps: Fry the onion in 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and curry paste and stir 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook 4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, ½ cup water, the sugar and 1 tsp salt. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pepper for the last 5 minutes. Finish with lime juice and herbs.

recipes.name: Chili garlic prawns
steps: Dry the prawns with kitchen paper.
Heat 2 tbsp oil and the butter. Fry the garlic and chili for 30 seconds.
Add the prawns and cook 2 minutes per side until pink.
Add the soy sauce and honey and toss 30 seconds. Finish with lemon and spring onions.
recipes.tip: Prawns turn rubbery fast: take them off as soon as they curl and turn pink.

recipes.name: Nasi goreng
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and chili in 2 tbsp oil for 3 minutes (add chicken or prawns now if using, and cook through).
Add the rice and stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, ketchup and sugar and toss until the rice is evenly coloured.
Fry the eggs separately and put one on each plate of rice, with cucumber and tomato on the side.

recipes.name: Chicken adobo
steps: Put the chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves, pepper and ½ cup water in a pot.
Bring to the boil, then cover and simmer 25 minutes.
Lift out the chicken and brown it in a hot oiled pan for 3 minutes per side.
Boil the sauce 5 minutes to reduce, add the sugar, and pour it over the chicken. Serve with rice.
recipes.tip: Don't stir for the first few minutes after the vinegar goes in; it cooks off more gently.
recipes.pressure: Put the chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves and pepper in the pot with only ¼ cup water. Cook 10 minutes at high pressure and let the pressure drop by itself for 5 minutes. Then brown the chicken and reduce the sauce (steps 3–4).

recipes.name: Sweet and sour chicken
steps: Toss the chicken in beaten egg (if using), then in 2 tbsp of the cornflour with a pinch of salt.
Fry in 3 tbsp oil for 7 minutes until golden and cooked. Air fryer: spray with oil, 200°C for 12 minutes.
Mix the ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, the last 1 tbsp cornflour and ½ cup water.
Stir-fry the pepper, onion and garlic 3 minutes. Pour in the sauce and bubble 1 minute until thick.
Toss in the chicken and serve straight away with rice.

recipes.name: Harees
need: 2 cups harees wheat (jareesh) or coarse bulgur, soaked overnight
500 g lamb or chicken on the bone
steps: Drain the soaked wheat and put it in a big pot with the meat, 8 cups water and 1½ tsp salt.
Bring to the boil and skim off the foam.
Cover and simmer on low for 2½ hours, stirring every 20 minutes so it doesn't stick. Add hot water if it gets too thick.
Lift out the meat, remove the bones, shred it and return it to the pot.
Beat hard with a wooden spoon for 5 minutes (or a few short pulses with a hand blender) until smooth and stretchy.
Serve hot with melted ghee poured on top and a pinch of cinnamon.
recipes.pressure: Put the soaked wheat, meat, salt and 6 cups water in the pot. Cook 45 minutes at high pressure and let the pressure drop by itself. Remove the bones, then beat until smooth and stretchy.
recipes.tip: Harees should be thick, smooth and slightly stretchy, like a porridge you can hold on a spoon.

recipes.name: Luqaimat (sweet dumplings)
need: date syrup or honey, to drizzle
steps: Mix the flour, cornflour, yeast, sugar, cardamom, saffron and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the warm water a little at a time to make a thick, sticky batter, like very thick pancake batter.
Cover and leave in a warm place for 40 minutes until bubbly and doubled.
Heat oil about 5 cm deep over medium heat. A drop of batter should sizzle and rise slowly.
Drop small balls of batter into the oil using two teaspoons dipped in water. Fry 5 minutes, turning, until golden all over.
Drain on paper, drizzle with date syrup and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Eat warm.
recipes.tip: If the oil is too hot they brown outside but stay raw inside. Fry a test one first.

recipes.name: Balaleet (sweet vermicelli with eggs)
extra: a pinch of saffron in 2 tbsp warm water
steps: Toast the vermicelli in the ghee or 1 tbsp oil over medium heat for 3 minutes until golden.
Add 2 cups water, the sugar, cardamom, saffron water and rose water. Simmer 8 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Cover and leave on the lowest heat for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and cook a thin omelette in a little oil.
Serve the vermicelli with the omelette on top.
recipes.tip: A classic Emirati breakfast: sweet and salty together.

recipes.name: Chicken saloona
steps: Fry the onions in 3 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, baharat and turmeric and stir 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and tomato paste and cook 5 minutes until soft.
Add the potatoes, carrots, dried lime, 4 cups water and 1½ tsp salt. Cover and simmer 25 minutes, adding the zucchini for the last 10 minutes.
Top with coriander and serve with rice.
recipes.pressure: After step 4, add the potatoes, carrots, dried lime, salt and 2½ cups water. Cook 8 minutes at high pressure, release the pressure, add the zucchini and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Thareed (meat stew over bread)
steps: Fry the onions in 3 tbsp oil for 8 minutes. Add the baharat and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the meat and brown 5 minutes, then the tomatoes for 5 minutes.
Add 5 cups water, 1½ tsp salt and the dried lime. Simmer covered: lamb 50 minutes, chicken 25 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots for 20 minutes, and the zucchini for the last 10 minutes.
Tear the bread into a deep serving dish in layers and ladle over enough broth to soak it.
Arrange the meat and vegetables on top and serve straight away.
recipes.pressure: For lamb: after browning, add the water, salt and dried lime and cook 25 minutes at high pressure. Release, add the vegetables and simmer 15 minutes.
recipes.tip: A favourite at Ramadan iftar.

recipes.name: Chebab (Emirati pancakes)
steps: Whisk the flour, yeast, sugar, cardamom, saffron and a pinch of salt.
Whisk in the egg and warm milk until smooth, like thick pancake batter.
Cover and leave 30 minutes until bubbly.
Heat a pan over medium-low heat and wipe with a little butter. Pour in a small ladle of batter.
Cook 2 minutes until bubbles cover the top, flip and cook 1 minute more.
Serve warm with date syrup and cream cheese.

recipes.name: Dango (spiced chickpeas)
steps: Warm the chickpeas with ½ cup water and ½ tsp salt for 5 minutes.
Drain well.
Toss with the cumin, chili powder, ½ tsp black pepper and the lemon juice.
Add the green chili and coriander and serve warm in small cups.
recipes.tip: A popular snack for Ramadan and Eid gatherings.

recipes.name: Karak chai
need: 2 tea bags or 2 tsp black tea
steps: Boil 1½ cups water with the cardamom (and ginger) for 3 minutes.
Add the tea and sugar and boil 3 minutes until very dark.
Pour in the milk and bring it up to the boil, then lower the heat as it rises. Do this three times, about 3 minutes.
Strain into cups and serve hot.
recipes.tip: Letting it rise three times is what makes karak thick and strong.

recipes.name: Samak mashwi (Gulf grilled fish)
need: 2 fish fillets or 1 whole fish (hammour, kingfish or sea bream)
steps: Mix the garlic, spices, juice of half the lemon, 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt into a paste.
Rub it all over the fish (make a few slits first if it's whole). Leave 10 minutes.
Cook: air fryer 200°C for 12 minutes; oven at 220°C for 15 minutes (whole fish 25 minutes); or in a hot oiled pan 4 minutes per side.
Squeeze over the rest of the lemon, add coriander and serve with rice.
recipes.tip: The fish is done when it flakes easily at the thickest part.

recipes.name: Margoogat (stew with thin dough)
steps: For the dough, mix the flour with ½ tsp salt and about ⅓ cup water. Knead 3 minutes until smooth, cover and rest 15 minutes.
Fry the onions in 3 tbsp oil for 8 minutes, add the spices for 1 minute, then the chicken for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes for 5 minutes, then 4 cups water, 1½ tsp salt and the dried lime. Simmer 20 minutes.
Add the vegetables and simmer 10 minutes.
Roll the dough very thin, cut it into 5 cm squares and drop them into the simmering stew one by one. Cook 10 minutes until tender.
Rest 5 minutes, top with coriander and serve.
recipes.tip: Roll the dough as thin as you can: it thickens the stew as it cooks.

recipes.name: Fresh mint tea
need: 1 tbsp green tea or 2 black tea bags
steps: Boil 2½ cups water.
Rinse the tea with a splash of the hot water and pour that away.
Add the mint, sugar and the rest of the water to the teapot and leave 4 minutes.
Pour from high up into small glasses so it foams a little.
recipes.tip: Go easy on the brewing time with green tea: longer makes it bitter.

recipes.name: Ginger, lemon and honey tea
need: a thumb-size piece of ginger, sliced
steps: Simmer the ginger (and cinnamon) in 2½ cups water for 8 minutes.
Take off the heat and squeeze in half the lemon.
Stir in the honey once it has cooled a little.
Pour into mugs with a slice of the remaining lemon.
recipes.tip: Good for a sore throat. Don't boil the honey; add it when the tea is just hot.

recipes.name: Sage tea (maramiya)
need: 1 tsp dried sage or a few mint leaves
steps: Boil 2½ cups water.
Add the tea bags, sage and sugar and leave 4 minutes.
Strain into glasses.
recipes.tip: A Levantine favourite after a heavy meal.

recipes.name: Chamomile and honey tea
steps: Boil 2½ cups water and pour it over the chamomile (and aniseed).
Cover and leave 5 minutes.
Strain and stir in the honey.
recipes.tip: Caffeine-free, so it's a good one for the evening.

recipes.name: Karkade (hibiscus drink)
steps: Boil 4 cups water with the hibiscus (and cinnamon) for 5 minutes.
Take off the heat, stir in the sugar and leave 10 minutes.
Strain. Drink hot, or chill it and serve over ice with mint and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.tip: Deep red, sweet and tart. It keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.name: Peach iced tea
steps: Simmer the peaches and sugar in 1 cup water for 10 minutes, mashing a little.
Add 3 cups boiling water and the tea bags and leave 5 minutes.
Strain, then cool.
Pour over plenty of ice with lemon slices and mint.
recipes.tip: Make it the night before and keep it in the fridge; it's even better cold.

recipes.name: Lemon mint juice (limonana)
steps: Put the lemons, mint, sugar, ice and 1 cup cold water in the blender.
Blend 1 minute until frothy and green.
Taste, add more sugar if it's too sour, and serve straight away.
recipes.tip: Remove the pips first; peel the lemons so it isn't bitter.

recipes.name: Mango lassi
steps: Put everything in the blender.
Blend 1 minute until smooth.
Pour into glasses and sprinkle with cardamom.
recipes.tip: Frozen mango works well and makes it thicker.

recipes.name: Watermelon mint juice
steps: Blend the watermelon, mint and lime juice for 30 seconds.
Strain if you like it smooth.
Serve over ice (stir in soaked chia or basil seeds if you have them).
recipes.tip: No sugar needed if the watermelon is ripe.

recipes.name: Date milkshake
steps: Soak the dates in a little hot water for 5 minutes if they're dry.
Blend everything for 1 minute until smooth.
Serve cold.
recipes.tip: Naturally sweet, so no sugar needed.

recipes.name: Iced coffee
extra: 2 tbsp condensed milk or 1 tbsp sugar
steps: Dissolve the coffee (and sugar) in 2 tbsp hot water.
Fill a glass with ice, pour in the milk, then the coffee.
For a Spanish latte, stir condensed milk into the glass first.

recipes.name: Date and nut energy balls
steps: Blend the nuts and oats until finely chopped.
Add the dates (and cocoa and peanut butter) and blend until the mix sticks together when pressed. Add 1 tbsp water if it's dry.
Roll into 12 small balls and roll them in coconut.
Chill 15 minutes. They keep a week in the fridge.
recipes.tip: No added sugar: the dates do the sweetening.

recipes.name: Chia pudding
extra: a handful of berries or mango
a few drops of vanilla flavouring
steps: Stir the chia seeds, milk, honey and vanilla together.
Wait 5 minutes and stir again so it doesn't clump.
Cover and chill at least 2 hours or overnight.
Top with fruit and nuts.
recipes.tip: Make it before bed for a ready breakfast.

recipes.name: Yogurt and fruit parfait
need: 1 cup berries or 1 banana or 1 mango
steps: Chop the fruit.
Layer yogurt, fruit and oats in two glasses, twice.
Drizzle with honey and top with nuts.
recipes.tip: Greek yogurt makes it thicker and higher in protein.

recipes.name: Banana oat cookies
extra: ¼ cup raisins or chopped dates
steps: Mash the bananas well and stir in the oats and extras.
Leave 5 minutes so the oats soften.
Drop 12 spoonfuls on a lined tray and flatten a little.
Bake at 180°C for 15 minutes until golden at the edges (air fryer: 170°C for 9 minutes).
recipes.tip: The riper (spottier) the bananas, the sweeter the cookies.

recipes.name: Baked cinnamon apples
steps: Cut the apples in half and scoop out the cores.
Fill with nuts and raisins, sprinkle with cinnamon and drizzle with honey.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until soft (air fryer: 180°C for 15 minutes).
Serve warm with a spoon of yogurt.

recipes.name: Banana ice cream (no sugar)
steps: Slice the bananas and freeze them for at least 4 hours (overnight is best).
Blend the frozen slices, stopping to scrape down, until smooth like soft-serve.
Blend in cocoa, peanut butter or dates if you like.
Eat straight away, or freeze 1 hour for a firmer scoop.
recipes.tip: Keep a bag of sliced ripe bananas in the freezer for this.

recipes.name: Umm Ali
extra: a few drops of vanilla flavouring
steps: Bake the puff pastry at 200°C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden, then break it into pieces in a baking dish.
Scatter over the nuts, raisins and coconut.
Heat the milk with the sugar, cinnamon and vanilla until steaming, then pour it over the pastry.
Pour the cream on top and bake at 220°C for 15 minutes until the top is golden.
Serve warm.
recipes.tip: Egypt's favourite bread pudding. Croissants or bread work instead of puff pastry.

recipes.name: Basbousa (semolina cake)
steps: For the syrup, boil 1 cup sugar with ¾ cup water and a squeeze of lemon for 5 minutes. Add the rose water and let it cool.
Mix the semolina, sugar, coconut, baking powder, yogurt and melted butter into a thick batter.
Spread in a buttered 25 cm tray, smooth the top and mark diamonds with a knife. Press an almond into each.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until golden.
Pour the cool syrup over the hot cake and leave 30 minutes to soak before cutting.
recipes.tip: Cool syrup on hot cake (or the other way round) stops it going soggy.

recipes.name: Rice pudding (roz bel laban)
steps: Simmer the rice in 1 cup water for 10 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Add the milk and simmer on low, stirring often, for 25 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir in the sugar, cardamom and rose water (and the cornflour mixed with a little cold milk for a thicker set) for 3 minutes.
Pour into bowls, cool and top with pistachios. Eat warm or cold.
recipes.tip: Stir from the bottom so the milk doesn't catch.

recipes.name: Muhallabia (milk pudding)
steps: Whisk the cornflour into 1 cup of the cold milk until smooth.
Heat the rest of the milk with the sugar, then whisk in the cornflour milk.
Stir over medium heat for 8 minutes until thick enough to coat the spoon. Stir in the rose water.
Pour into small bowls, cool, then chill 2 hours. Top with pistachios.

recipes.name: Chocolate brownies
need: 200 g dark chocolate or ½ cup cocoa powder
extra: a few drops of vanilla flavouring
steps: Melt the chocolate and butter together over low heat (with cocoa, just melt the butter and stir the cocoa in).
Whisk in the sugar, then the eggs one at a time, and the vanilla.
Fold in the flour and a pinch of salt (and the nuts).
Spread in a lined 20 cm tin and bake at 180°C for 25 minutes. The middle should still be a little soft.
Cool completely before cutting into squares.
recipes.tip: Take them out while the middle still wobbles slightly: they firm up as they cool.

recipes.name: Sheer khurma
steps: Fry the vermicelli in the ghee for 3 minutes until golden. Take it out.
Briefly fry the nuts, dates and raisins in the same pan.
Add the milk and cardamom and simmer 15 minutes, stirring, until a little thicker.
Add the vermicelli, sugar and saffron and simmer 5 minutes more.
Serve warm or chilled.
recipes.tip: The traditional Eid breakfast in Pakistan and India.

recipes.name: Joojeh kabab (saffron chicken)
need: 800 g boneless chicken, in big cubes
a pinch of saffron in 3 tbsp hot water
steps: Mix the yogurt, grated onion, juice of 1 lemon, half the saffron water, 2 tbsp oil and 1½ tsp salt. Stir in the chicken and leave at least 30 minutes (overnight is best).
Thread the chicken onto skewers, or spread it on a tray.
Cook: air fryer 200°C for 14 minutes, turning once; oven grill 12 minutes per side; or a hot oiled pan 10 minutes, turning.
Brush with the melted butter mixed with the rest of the saffron water.
Serve with grilled tomatoes, rice and lemon wedges, sprinkled with sumac.
recipes.tip: Grated onion and yogurt make the chicken very tender.

recipes.name: Ghormeh sabzi (herb stew)
need: 500 g lamb or beef, in cubes
1 bunch chives or the green parts of 2 leeks
steps: Chop all the herbs very finely and fry them in 4 tbsp oil over medium-low heat for 15 minutes, stirring, until dark green and fragrant. Add the fenugreek for the last minute.
In a pot, fry the onion in 2 tbsp oil for 8 minutes, add the turmeric and the meat and brown 5 minutes.
Add 4 cups water and 1½ tsp salt, cover and simmer 60 minutes.
Add the fried herbs, beans and dried limes and simmer 40 minutes more until thick and dark.
Serve with rice.
recipes.pressure: After browning, add the water and salt and cook the meat 25 minutes at high pressure. Release, add the fried herbs, beans and dried limes and simmer 20 minutes without the lid.
recipes.tip: Frying the herbs slowly is the secret: don't rush it.

recipes.name: Persian rice with tahdig
need: a pinch of saffron in 3 tbsp hot water
extra: 1 potato, thinly sliced, for potato tahdig
steps: Boil a big pot of water with 3 tbsp salt. Add the drained rice and boil 6 minutes until soft outside but firm in the middle. Drain and rinse with lukewarm water.
Melt 2 tbsp butter with 2 tbsp oil in a non-stick pot. Mix 1 cup of the rice with the yogurt and half the saffron water and press it into the bottom (or lay potato slices instead).
Pile the rest of the rice on top in a mound. Poke 5 holes with a spoon handle.
Cover with a lid wrapped in a tea towel. Cook on medium heat 10 minutes, then on the lowest heat 45 minutes.
Drizzle the rest of the butter and saffron water over the top. Flip onto a plate, or serve the rice and break the crispy tahdig into pieces.
recipes.tip: The crispy bottom (tahdig) is the best part. A non-stick pot makes it easy.

recipes.name: Zereshk polo ba morgh (barberry rice with chicken)
need: 4 chicken legs or 800 g chicken pieces
½ cup barberries or dried cranberries
a pinch of saffron in 3 tbsp hot water
steps: Fry the onion in 2 tbsp oil for 8 minutes. Add the turmeric and chicken and brown 5 minutes. Add 1 cup water, 1 tsp salt and half the saffron water; cover and simmer 40 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the rice: boil 6 minutes in plenty of salted water, drain, then steam in a pot with 2 tbsp oil on the lowest heat for 35 minutes with the lid wrapped in a towel.
Rinse the barberries. Fry them in the butter with the sugar for 2 minutes only (they burn fast).
Mix a cup of rice with the rest of the saffron water.
Serve the white rice topped with the saffron rice, barberries and nuts, with the chicken and its sauce.
recipes.tip: Barberries are sold at Iranian shops and most big supermarkets in the UAE.

recipes.name: Kashk-e bademjan (eggplant dip)
steps: Fry the eggplant slices in oil until golden on both sides, or brush with oil and air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes. Mash them.
Fry the onion in 3 tbsp oil for 12 minutes until deep golden. Take out half for the top.
Add the garlic and turmeric for 1 minute, then the mashed eggplant, ½ cup water and ½ tsp salt. Cook 10 minutes, stirring.
Stir in 3 tbsp kashk and cook 2 minutes.
Spread on a plate and top with the rest of the kashk, fried onion, walnuts and mint fried in a little oil. Eat with bread.
recipes.tip: No kashk? Use thick yogurt or labneh with a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Mirza ghasemi (smoky eggplant with eggs)
steps: Roast the whole eggplants directly over a gas flame (or under the oven grill) for 15 minutes, turning, until black and soft. Peel and chop.
Fry the garlic in 3 tbsp oil for 1 minute, then the turmeric and tomatoes for 6 minutes.
Add the eggplant and 1 tsp salt and cook 8 minutes.
Push to the sides, crack in the eggs, scramble them, then mix everything together.
Serve warm with bread.
recipes.tip: Charring the skin gives the smoky taste.

recipes.name: Kuku sabzi (herb frittata)
steps: Chop all the herbs and spring onions very finely.
Beat the eggs with the turmeric, baking powder, 1 tsp salt and pepper. Stir in the herbs, walnuts and barberries.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a non-stick pan, pour in the mix and smooth the top. Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Cut into quarters, flip each one and cook 8 minutes more (or finish in the oven at 180°C for 15 minutes).
Serve warm or cold with bread and yogurt.
recipes.tip: It should be mostly herbs held together by egg: deep green inside.

recipes.name: Khoresh gheymeh (split pea stew)
need: 400 g lamb or beef, in small cubes
extra: 2 potatoes, cut into thin fries, to top
steps: Fry the onion in 3 tbsp oil for 8 minutes. Add the turmeric, cinnamon and meat and brown 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the split peas, dried limes, 4 cups water and 1½ tsp salt. Cover and simmer 60 minutes until the meat is tender and the peas are soft but whole.
Meanwhile fry the potato sticks until crisp.
Serve with rice, topped with the crispy fries.
recipes.pressure: After step 2, add the split peas, dried limes, salt and 2½ cups water. Cook 20 minutes at high pressure and let the pressure drop by itself.

recipes.name: Greek salad
steps: Put the tomatoes, cucumber, onion, pepper and olives in a bowl.
Add a pinch of salt, the vinegar and 4 tbsp olive oil and toss.
Put the feta on top in one piece or big chunks, sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with a little more oil.
recipes.tip: No lettuce in a real Greek salad: just ripe tomatoes.

recipes.name: Chicken souvlaki with tzatziki
steps: Mix the juice of 1 lemon, 2 cloves crushed garlic, oregano, paprika, 3 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt. Add the chicken and leave 20 minutes.
For the tzatziki, grate the cucumber, squeeze out the water and mix with the yogurt, the last clove of garlic and a pinch of salt.
Thread the chicken onto skewers and cook: air fryer 200°C for 12 minutes; oven grill 10 minutes per side; or a hot pan 8 minutes.
Warm the bread and fill with chicken, tzatziki, tomato and onion. Squeeze over lemon.

recipes.name: Chicken and vegetable paella
steps: Brown the chicken in 3 tbsp oil in a wide pan for 8 minutes. Push to the side.
Fry the onion and pepper 5 minutes, then the grated tomato and paprika for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice, then add 3½ cups hot water with the stock cube and saffron. Spread the rice evenly and don't stir again.
Simmer 18 minutes, adding the peas and prawns on top for the last 6 minutes.
Turn up the heat for 1 minute to crisp the bottom, rest 5 minutes covered, then serve with lemon and parsley.
recipes.tip: Not stirring is what makes the crispy bottom (socarrat).

recipes.name: Moroccan chicken tagine
steps: Rub the chicken with the spices, garlic, 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt.
Brown it in a heavy pot for 6 minutes. Add the onions and cook 5 minutes.
Add 1 cup water, the cinnamon and saffron. Cover and simmer 35 minutes.
Add the olives and lemon (sliced, or preserved lemon if you have it) and cook uncovered 10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Top with coriander and serve with couscous or bread.

recipes.name: Menemen (Turkish eggs)
steps: Cook the peppers (and onion) in the butter and 1 tbsp oil for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and ½ tsp salt and cook 6 minutes until soft.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set but still soft.
Top with feta and chili flakes and eat with bread.

recipes.name: Minestrone soup
steps: Fry the onion, carrots and celery in 3 tbsp olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add the zucchini and oregano for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, 5 cups water and the stock cube. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add the beans and pasta and cook 10 minutes until the pasta is soft. Stir in the spinach.
Serve with parmesan and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
steps: Toss the chicken with the spices, 1 tbsp oil, half the lime juice and ½ tsp salt.
Cook the chicken in a very hot pan for 6 minutes until charred. Take it out.
Cook the peppers and onion 5 minutes until soft with some colour, then return the chicken and squeeze over the rest of the lime.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the chicken and peppers, avocado, sour cream and salsa.
recipes.tip: Get the pan really hot so the chicken chars instead of stewing.

recipes.name: Beef tacos
steps: Fry the onion in 1 tbsp oil for 4 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the spices, 1 tsp salt and ¼ cup water and simmer 5 minutes until saucy.
Warm the tortillas and fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese and sour cream. Squeeze over lime.

recipes.name: Guacamole
steps: Mash the avocados with a fork, leaving some chunks.
Stir in the lime juice, onion, chili, tomato, coriander and ½ tsp salt.
Taste, add more lime or salt, and serve straight away.
recipes.tip: Press cling film onto the surface if you make it ahead, so it stays green.

recipes.name: Chicken quesadillas
steps: Spread cheese, chicken, pepper and spring onions over half of each tortilla and sprinkle with cumin. Fold over.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.
recipes.tip: Great for leftover roast chicken.

recipes.name: Burrito bowl
steps: Cook the rice. Stir in the juice of half the lime and some coriander.
Cook the chicken (in strips) or beef with the spices and ½ tsp salt for 8 minutes until done.
Warm the beans and corn.
Build bowls: rice, meat, beans, corn, tomato, lettuce, avocado, cheese and a spoon of sour cream.

recipes.name: Mexican rice
need: 2 tbsp tomato paste or 2 tomatoes, blended
steps: Fry the rice in 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes until lightly golden.
Add the onion and garlic for 2 minutes, then the tomato and cumin for 1 minute.
Add 2¾ cups water, the stock cube, peas and carrot. Boil, then cover and cook on low for 18 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes, fluff and add coriander.

recipes.name: Huevos rancheros
steps: Fry the onion and chili in 2 tbsp oil for 4 minutes, add the cumin, then the tomatoes and ½ tsp salt. Simmer 8 minutes.
Warm the beans.
Fry the eggs and warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Put tortillas on plates, then beans, eggs and the tomato sauce. Top with avocado, cheese and coriander.

recipes.name: Chicken enchiladas
steps: For the sauce, fry the onion 5 minutes, add the spices, then the tomatoes and ½ tsp salt. Simmer 10 minutes and blend or mash.
Mix the chicken (and beans) with half the cheese and 4 tbsp of the sauce.
Fill and roll the tortillas and lay them in a baking dish, seam down.
Pour over the rest of the sauce and cheese. Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until bubbling (air fryer: 180°C for 12 minutes in a small dish).
Top with sour cream and coriander.

recipes.name: Beef bulgogi (Korean)
need: 500 g beef steak, very thinly sliced
extra: rice and lettuce leaves, to serve
steps: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, garlic, sesame oil and grated apple. Add the beef and onion and leave 20 minutes.
Cook in a very hot pan in batches for 2 minutes per batch until caramelised.
Top with spring onions and sesame seeds. Serve with rice, or wrapped in lettuce leaves.
recipes.tip: Freeze the beef for 30 minutes first: it's much easier to slice thinly.

recipes.name: Chicken katsu (Japanese)
steps: Slice each breast in half sideways and flatten to 1 cm. Season with salt and pepper.
Coat in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs (panko is best).
Fry in 1 cm of oil for 3 minutes per side until golden, or spray with oil and air fry at 200°C for 12 minutes.
Mix the ketchup, worcestershire, soy and sugar for the sauce.
Slice and serve with rice, shredded cabbage and the sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken pad thai
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes until soft but chewy. Drain.
Mix the soy sauce, sugar, tamarind, fish sauce and juice of half the lime.
Stir-fry the garlic and chicken in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes. Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss 2 minutes. Add the bean sprouts and spring onions for 30 seconds.
Serve with peanuts, chili flakes and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Miso soup
steps: Heat 3 cups water with the seaweed and mushrooms until just simmering, 3 minutes.
Take off the heat. Mix the miso with a little of the hot water until smooth, then stir it in.
Add the tofu, warm through for 1 minute without boiling, and top with spring onions.
recipes.tip: Never boil miso: it loses its flavour.

recipes.name: Chili con carne
steps: Fry the onion and pepper in 2 tbsp oil for 6 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the beef and brown 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the spices and tomato paste for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, ½ cup water and 1 tsp salt. Simmer 25 minutes.
Add the beans and simmer 10 minutes more.
Serve with rice, sour cream and cheese.
recipes.tip: Even better the next day.

recipes.name: Crispy chicken wings
extra: celery and carrot sticks, to serve
steps: Pat the wings very dry. Toss with the baking powder, garlic powder, paprika and 1 tsp salt.
Air fry at 200°C for 22 minutes, shaking twice; or bake on a rack at 220°C for 40 minutes, turning once.
For buffalo wings, toss in hot sauce mixed with melted butter. For honey wings, use honey and a splash of soy sauce.
Serve with celery and carrot sticks.
recipes.tip: Baking powder (not soda) is the trick for crisp skin without frying.

recipes.name: Shepherd's pie
need: 500 g minced lamb or minced beef
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes until soft. Mash with the butter, milk and salt.
Fry the onion and carrots 6 minutes, add the mince and brown 6 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, worcestershire, thyme, stock cube and 1 cup water. Simmer 15 minutes, adding the peas at the end.
Spread the meat in a dish, top with the mash and rough it up with a fork (add cheese if you like).
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden on top.
recipes.tip: Made with beef it's called cottage pie.

imageCredit.artist: Abhinaba Basu from Redmond, United States

recipes.name: Chicken schnitzel
steps: Slice the breasts in half sideways and pound them thin, about ½ cm. Season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Coat in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in 1 cm of hot oil for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden, or spray with oil and air fry at 200°C for 10 minutes, turning once.
Serve with lemon wedges and parsley, with potatoes or salad.

recipes.name: Beef stroganoff
need: 500 g beef steak, in thin strips
extra: rice, pasta or mash, to serve
steps: Season the beef and sear it in a very hot pan with 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes in batches. Take it out.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in the butter for 8 minutes until browned.
Add the paprika and mustard, then the cream, and simmer 3 minutes.
Return the beef with its juices and heat 1 minute. Top with parsley and serve with rice, pasta or mash.
recipes.tip: Don't overcook the beef: it only needs a quick sear.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar salad
steps: Season and cook the chicken in a hot pan with 1 tbsp oil for 6 minutes per side. Rest, then slice.
Cube the bread, toss with 1 tbsp oil and toast in the pan for 5 minutes until crisp.
For the dressing, mix the mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic, mustard, worcestershire, half the parmesan and a splash of water.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing and top with the chicken, croutons and the rest of the parmesan.

recipes.name: Harira (Moroccan lentil and chickpea soup)
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a big pot. Cook the onion and celery for 5 minutes.
Stir in the turmeric, cinnamon, ginger and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 6 cups water. Simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Add the chickpeas, vermicelli and half the herbs. Simmer 5 minutes more. Add salt and pepper.
Serve with the rest of the herbs, lemon wedges and dates.
recipes.tip: For a meat version, brown 250 g diced lamb with the onion and simmer 20 minutes longer.

recipes.name: Chicken and vegetable soup
steps: Put the chicken, onion, garlic, bay leaf and 7 cups water in a pot. Bring to the boil, skim, and simmer 20 minutes.
Lift out the chicken. Add the carrots, celery, potatoes, stock cube and oregano and simmer 15 minutes.
Shred the chicken off the bones and put it back with the peas. Simmer 3 minutes.
Add salt, pepper and parsley. Serve with bread.
recipes.tip: Boneless chicken works too: cut it small and add it with the vegetables.

recipes.name: Tomato soup
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pot. Cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, 2 cups water, the stock cube and sugar. Simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth. Add salt and pepper.
Stir in the cream if you like, and serve with basil and bread.
recipes.tip: Grilled cheese sandwiches turn this into a full dinner.

recipes.name: Creamy pumpkin soup
extra: ½ cup cream or coconut milk
a few toasted nuts, to serve
steps: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pot. Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the pumpkin, potato, stock cube and 4 cups water. Simmer 20 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth. Stir in the cream or coconut milk and add salt and pepper.
Serve with a few seeds on top.
recipes.tip: Butternut squash or sweet potato work the same way.

recipes.name: Chicken corn soup
steps: Simmer the chicken and ginger in 6 cups water for 15 minutes. Lift out the chicken and shred it.
Add the corn, stock cube, soy sauce and shredded chicken to the pot and bring back to a simmer.
Mix the cornflour with ½ cup cold water and stir it in until the soup thickens.
Pour in the eggs in a thin stream while stirring slowly, so they set in ribbons.
Serve with spring onions, and hot sauce and vinegar at the table.
recipes.tip: Creamed corn makes it thicker and sweeter, like the street-stall version.

recipes.name: Chicken vermicelli soup (Shorbat dajaj)
steps: Put the chicken, onion, cardamom, cinnamon, bay leaf and 7 cups water in a pot. Simmer 25 minutes, skimming the top.
Lift out the chicken, strain the broth and put it back in the pot. Shred the chicken.
Toast the vermicelli in 1 tbsp oil until golden, then add it to the broth with the carrot and stock cube. Simmer 8 minutes.
Add the chicken back, salt and pepper. Serve with parsley and lemon.
recipes.tip: A popular Ramadan starter; a squeeze of lemon at the table makes it.

recipes.name: Thai coconut chicken soup
steps: Simmer the lemongrass and ginger in 3 cups water with the stock cube for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and chicken and simmer gently for 6 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and chili and cook 3 minutes more.
Turn off the heat. Stir in the fish sauce and lemon juice, and taste. Serve with coriander.
recipes.tip: Don't eat the lemongrass and ginger pieces; they're only for flavour.

imageCredit.artist: Evan Joshua Swigart (TheCulinaryGeek) from Chicago, Illinois, USA; hometown of A

recipes.name: Mexican chicken tortilla soup
steps: Fry the tortilla strips in a little oil until crisp. Drain on paper.
In a pot, cook the onion 5 minutes, then the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chicken, stock cube and 5 cups water. Simmer 15 minutes. Shred the chicken and add the beans.
Serve topped with tortilla strips, avocado, cheese, coriander and lemon.
recipes.tip: Short on time? Bake the tortilla strips at 200 °C for 8 minutes instead of frying.

recipes.name: Greek lemon chicken soup (Avgolemono)
steps: Simmer the chicken and onion in 6 cups water with the stock cube for 15 minutes. Lift out the chicken and shred it; discard the onion.
Add the rice and simmer 12 minutes until soft.
Whisk the eggs and lemon juice. Slowly whisk in 2 ladles of hot broth, then pour it all back into the pot off the heat.
Stir until silky (don't boil again or the eggs split). Add the chicken, salt, pepper and dill.
recipes.tip: Reheat gently; boiling turns it grainy.

recipes.name: Grilled chicken with tabbouleh
steps: Soak the bulgur in ½ cup boiling water for 15 minutes.
Rub the chicken with oil, garlic, paprika, salt and half the lemon juice. Cook in a hot pan 6 minutes a side.
Mix the bulgur with the parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber, spring onion, the rest of the lemon juice, 3 tbsp oil and salt.
Slice the chicken and serve on the tabbouleh with sumac.
recipes.tip: Real tabbouleh is mostly parsley; don't skimp on it.

recipes.name: Lemon herb fish in foil
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Lay out two big sheets of foil.
Put the zucchini on each, then the fish, tomatoes, garlic, olives and lemon slices. Add oregano, salt, pepper and 1 tbsp oil each.
Fold the foil into sealed parcels and bake 15 minutes.
Open carefully (hot steam) and add dill.
recipes.tip: Any white fish works: hammour, sea bream, tilapia or frozen fillets.

recipes.name: Chickpea salad (Balela)
steps: Put the chickpeas, tomato, cucumber, onion, parsley and mint in a bowl.
Dress with the lemon juice, 3 tbsp oil, sumac and salt.
Leave 10 minutes so the flavours soak in, then serve with flatbread.
recipes.tip: Add a tin of tuna or a boiled egg for more protein.

recipes.name: Chicken lettuce wraps
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a hot pan. Cook the chicken 5 minutes until browned.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, honey and sesame oil. Toss 1 minute.
Spoon into lettuce leaves and top with carrot, spring onion and sesame seeds.
recipes.tip: Iceberg or little gem leaves make the best cups.

recipes.name: Garlic tofu with broccoli
steps: Pat the tofu dry and toss in the cornflour. Fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden on all sides. Set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli 3 minutes with a splash of water.
Add the garlic for 1 minute, then the tofu, soy sauce, honey and sesame oil. Toss until coated.
Top with chili flakes and sesame seeds. Eat as it is, or with a little rice.
recipes.tip: Press the tofu between kitchen paper for 10 minutes first for a crispier result.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka with cucumber raita
steps: Mix half the yogurt with the garam masala, paprika, ginger, garlic, lemon juice and salt. Coat the chicken (10 minutes or up to a day).
Cook: air fryer 200 °C for 12 minutes, oven 220 °C for 18 minutes, or a hot oiled pan 10 minutes, turning.
For the raita, squeeze the cucumber and mix with the rest of the yogurt, mint and a pinch of salt.
Serve the chicken with raita, onion rings and salad.
recipes.tip: Thread the chicken on skewers if you have them.

recipes.name: Persian lentil stew (Adasi)
steps: Simmer the lentils and potato in 4 cups water for 25 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile fry the onion in 3 tbsp oil until deep golden, about 12 minutes. Add the garlic, turmeric and cumin for 1 minute.
Stir half the onions into the lentils and mash a little so it thickens. Add salt and pepper.
Serve topped with the rest of the onions and the mint, with lemon and bread.
recipes.tip: In Iran this is eaten for breakfast or a light dinner on cold days.

recipes.name: Black bean and corn salad
steps: Mix the beans, corn, tomato, pepper and onion in a bowl.
Dress with the lemon juice, 2 tbsp oil, cumin and salt.
Fold in the avocado and coriander just before serving, with tortillas or chips.
recipes.tip: Black beans are best, but kidney beans work too.

recipes.name: Tuna, egg and green bean salad
steps: Boil the potatoes 10 minutes. Add the eggs and green beans for the last 7 minutes.
Drain, cool the eggs in cold water and peel them.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar, 3 tbsp oil, salt and pepper.
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, olives, tuna and halved eggs. Pour over the dressing.
recipes.tip: Skip the potatoes for an even lighter plate.
